findings.text: the tests field, and the command of both baseline_suite and after_suite, carry the unsubstituted placeholders <tree> and <bt> where the field rule asks for the gate command that actually ran; the substituted command exists only in the arm logs' own '# command:' header (logs/arm-base.log:4), so a reader holding the manifest alone cannot re-run the gate the record scores.

the stated ruff figures '26 findings at base, 21 at head' do not reproduce as given: measured against the same blobs with the repository's own pyproject and the shared ruff 0.16.4, the base files carry 24 findings (13 + 11) and the head files 21 (11 + 10). The head figure and the zero-added conclusion hold — the head's finding set is a strict subset of the base's, losing only the fixed '/tmp/node-a-manifest.md' S108 — but the base figure is overstated by two and no log backs either number.

the gate's own stop condition was not honoured: 'Stop and log df if /tmp has under 5 GB free', and logs/df-at-start.txt records 2.8 GB free before the base arm. Both arms ran in /tmp anyway and it ended at 1.1 GB free (98%), as logs/arm-base.log and logs/arm-head.log record; the manifest discloses the figure, but the run proceeded where its measure said stop.
